strapiBlog.title: Live like Royalty in These Amazing Luxury Homes in Dubai

data.text:
Dubai… A land of luxury. A place where opulence knows no bounds. A city of absolute wonderment. And it is here that you can find some of the most exclusive, luxurious, and once-in-a-lifetime kind of homes. When you live in Dubai, you live a lifestyle that everyone is envious of and desires. Offering the highest quality of life, if you are looking for that perfect home to compliment your high-end lifestyle, check out the following picks of luxurious projects in Dubai, offering a variety of villas and apartments.

THE HEART OF EUROPE

If you want to see a world of impossible possibilities, The Heart of Europe is it! Home to 7 islands representing the world map, this is one of the world’s best luxury investment options. The Heart of Europe offers many firsts in the world of luxury and exclusiveness.

This includes

  • First Underwater Hotel with Gym & Spa
  • First 5-star Exclusive Family Hotel
  • First-Ever Dedicated Wedding Hotel
  • World’s First Artificial Rainy Streets
  • First Floating and Underwater Living Experience
  • 7 islands with 50+ yearly attractions
  • 13 hotels and resorts

The villas in this stunning location offer floating villas with underwater living, Bentley furnishings, as well as beachfront and lagoon villas with private gardens and more. They also have palaces that are inspired by Swedish Viking Vessels. At The Heart of Europe, you can also find luxury beach resorts and family hotels that are a class apart. These properties are reflective of the opulent lifestyle that Dubai has to offer.

ONE PALM

Ever fancied being one of only 94 exclusive home-owners to live in an incredible waterfront apartment in the most coveted address in the world, Palm Jumeirah? Well then, One Palm by Omniyat is for you. Welcome to the future of elegance, extravagance and elite living.

One Palm at Palm Jumeirah is home to an exquisite collection of just 94 aesthetically crafted apartments offering 3 & 4 bedrooms as well as penthouses. A trophy asset with views that you can only dream of, of the blue Arabian sea and the exquisite Dubai skyline.

  • Luxury Trophy Asset
  • Exclusive, High-End, & Ready Property
  • Limited 3 & 4 BR Waterfront Apartments & Penthouses
  • Large Terraces
  • Double Height Ceiling
  • Floor-to-ceiling Windows
  • Designer Interiors

Each apartment has its interiors designed by Japan’s famous interior design company, Super Potato, and Elicyon, with excellent lush landscaping by Vladimir Djurovic. Completely managed by Dorchester Collection, providing a la carte services and concierge services, One Palm is the epitome of innovative architecture and a lifestyle perfect for the aristocrats.

BVLGARI RESIDENCES

An exclusive and rare collection of BVLGARI residences, these homes are located on a private island with the most exquisite BVLGARI lifestyle, overlooking the Arabian Gulf. The BVLGARI Resorts & Residences in Dubai is the 5th in the world by BVLGARI.

It is the first-of-its-kind master community in terms of scale and magnitude by BVLGARI. It is spread over 1.7 million square feet of area in the Jumeirah Bay Island overlooking the beautiful beaches.

  • A trophy asset: It is a rare opportunity to own an apartment in one of the only 5 BVLGARI developments.
  • The epitome of exclusivity: Own your private berth in the BVLGARI Marina & Yacht Club
  • An Italian beachy love story: Inspired by Portofino, the promenade is private for the residents only.

The development has adopted the island lifestyle and reflects that in the Italian Portofino-inspired architecture of the entire project. A 6 million square feet of the mixed-use island developed by Meraas, Jumeirah Bay is shaped like a Titanic Seahorse and is on the coast of JBR. You can access it via a 300-metre bridge. It offers amazingly enthralling views of the vast sea.

data.text:
DISTRICT ONE

Beautiful waterfront homes await you amidst the beauty of nature & a meandering lagoon in District One, MBR City. The only project in Dubai named after H.H. Sheikh Mohamed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, this is the ultimate lifestyle you need. It is located minutes from Downtown Dubai. The Mediterranean and Contemporary styled villas reflect minimalism with their sleek finishes and elegant interiors. Arabic influence makes the Arabesque style homes perfect for large families.

  • Meandering Crystal Lagoon:  District One, you come home to a beautiful and the world’s largest man-made crystal lagoon that snakes through the entire community.
  • Meydan One Mall: Residents of District One will enjoy the ease of access to the biggest mall to be built in Dubai, the Meydan One Mall. 
  • Greenery All Around You: With 60% of green coverage, District One offers ample lush greenery.

At District One, you come home to a beautiful and the world’s largest man-made crystal lagoon that snakes through the entire community. Enjoy a quick swim in the waters or engage in non-motor water sporting activities like kayaking, paddle-boating and more. Nestled within the coveted MBR City, District One’s Residences redefine luxury lifestyle with amazing amenities and beautiful homes. If you choose to live in District One, you are choosing an ideal waterfront life surrounded by the beautiful tranquillity of nature.

IL PRIMO

Il Primo at the Opera District in Downtown Dubai. Il Primo is the crown jewel of the Emaar portfolio – if you are seeking the best Penthouse in Dubai there simply is no alternative. Located next to Burj Khalifa offering the best fountain views possible, Il Primo offers exclusively half floor or full floor Penthouse apartments. Residents can experience life in spacious, masterfully crafted apartments with an unparalleled breadth of amenities surrounded by spellbinding views and year-round entertainment.

  • The most exquisite views of the Burj Khalifa
  • Unparalleled amenities like a Cigar Lounge, Games Room, Library, Movie Theatre, Infinity Pools and more.
  • The epitome of style and contemporary class, the interiors of Il Primo are tastefully designed and crafted.
  • The design draws inspiration from the luxuriously appointed building exterior, larger-than-life and theatrical, to rival its surroundings.

Providing the ultimate metropolitan lifestyle abounding with world-class landmarks, entertainment and glamour, Downtown Dubai is a true heart of the emirate. The generous lifestyle offered at Il Primo is a gorgeous place for entertaining, dining or simply soaking in the views over Dubai’s ever astounding Burj Khalifa.

So if you’re looking for that opulent lifestyle, look no further than Dubai. This is where the world comes to realise their dreams. If any of the above projects are of interest to you, be sure to get in touch with Zoya Ventures Real Estate. Let’s make your luxury fantasies a reality.
